text_block_list.text:
"Introduced as an ally to Umamusume and 
Trainers, the 'Mega Dream Supporter.'"

An orientation was to be held, and 
Trainers and Umamusume were gathered in 
the VR space.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer <username>! We're in the same time slot 
for the orientation!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Hello. ......Good afternoon.

This Umamusume with a unique presence, 
whom I had met once before, was Happy 
Meek, trained by Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We only had a brief introduction last 
time, so I'm really grateful to have an 
opportunity like this.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I have to make sure I learn the exact 
differences between this and the VR 
Umalator!"

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the VR world, fellow Trainers! 
We'll be your guides for today!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
It basically follows the same functions as 
the VR Umulator, but I'll explain 
everything without skipping as a review.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
If you have any questions, do not hesitate 
to ask. Moving forward without 
understanding is the way of a fool.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, let's go ahead and start our 
rounds~

And so, the Trainer and the Umamusume 
toured the facility, guided by the Three 
Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A gym, a pool, and training tracks. 
Everything that was in the VR Umalator is 
here.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the fact that the feedback system 
places a physical strain on the body in 
reality is the same.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Even during training in VR, an 
Umamusume's physical conditioning must be 
properly managed... right! I absolutely 
cannot let Meek get injured!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...From what we've seen so far, the only 
real difference from the VR Umalator is 
the presence of the Three Goddesses."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's definitely a big difference, 
but there's one more thing you can only 
find right here.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Now, to finish things off, shall I show 
you to a very special place?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A 'special place'...? The racetrack? We 
have that in the VR Umalator too, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I didn't bring you here to show you the 
place itself, but rather to introduce the 
race held here.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, our role as the Three Goddesses is 
to support Umamusume and Trainers. Your 
growth is our greatest wish.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"And it is precisely because we hope, that 
we want to see your growth—"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, we shall prepare a 'Special 
Race' as a stage to measure the 
Umamusume's true abilities."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A "Special Race" to measure an Umamusume's 
true ability...!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
A grand stage held once a year from the 
Junior to Senior Classes, where only those 
whose potential is recognized by the Three 
Goddesses are invited.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"There are three special races: the Grow 
Up Race, the WBC, and the SWBC. Only a 
handful of Umamusume can enter any of 
them, but—"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Only the Umamusume who prove their talent 
there will advance to even greater 
heights—the "Grand Masters."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"...And on that stage, your opponents 
shall be us, the Three Goddesses."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Our opponents are the Three Goddesses...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We're running with the Three 
Goddesses...!? That's incredible...! That 
normally never happens!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Just like in the picture book... ...The 
Three Goddesses... it makes me itch to 
run...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
—And while I've explained the race to you, 
it wouldn't be fair if you didn't know 
what we're truly capable of.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
And that is precisely why I went through 
the trouble of bringing you all the way 
out to the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: We will now hold the mock race.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"Etch into your memory the true strength 
of us, who will be your opponents in the 
Grand Masters."

text_block_list.name: Trainer and Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A race against the Three Goddesses right 
now...!? Huh!? Even we get to run in 
it...!?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Participation is optional. Even just 
watching, you'll certainly be able to feel 
the spirit of our running.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"Please, experience for yourselves the 
running of the Three Goddesses that you 
strive for!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I'd be racing against the 
Three Goddesses... Still, it really might 
turn out to be a valuable experience.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...What about you, Meek? You haven't made 
your debut yet, but would you like to run?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...O Great Three Goddesses... ...Mmh... I 
want to try running..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Well, since we have the chance, let's join 
in!

Ahead lies the stage where she will 
directly compete against the Three 
Goddesses acting as her supporters—

With that being the case, even though <chrname> 
hasn't debuted yet, it was decided that we 
should get a sense of the opponent's true 
strength...!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the participants have been 
decided. Without further ado, let us begin 
the race.

And so, a mock race with the Three 
Goddesses was suddenly arranged, but—
It was utterly breathtaking.

The Three Goddesses' running was 
breathtaking enough to leave everyone 
present completely speechless—

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*... *gasp*... ...I couldn't... 
catch up at all...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There weren't just pre-debut girls out 
there—there were graded-stakes winners, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this is our running.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
After all, our running is the ultimate 
form, derived through countless trials 
based on massive amounts of data—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it is running worthy of 
the pinnacle of Umamusume.
choice_data_list:
A run worthy of the pinnacle of 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
You have seen the height of the mountain 
you must scale. All that is left is to 
climb it and claim the summit.

Now, the real races with <chrname> were about to 
begin—

In a racing career granted only once, one 
couldn't help but yearn to stand atop that 
soaring mountain peak.
